content.text:
An original speedy hedgehog mascot rather than Sega's Sonic character:

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 240" width="240" height="240">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="fur" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2bb3a3"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#127a70"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- speed lines -->
  <g stroke="#9fe3da" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".7">
    <line x1="8" y1="110" x2="48" y2="110"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="132" x2="52" y2="132"/>
    <line x1="4" y1="154" x2="44" y2="154"/>
  </g>

  <!-- back quills -->
  <path d="M70 120 L22 92 L72 96 L30 58 L84 76 L64 30 L108 66 L118 40 L132 70 Z"
        fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#0d4f49" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M68 168 L44 178 L70 182 Z" fill="#127a70" stroke="#0d4f49" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="112" cy="170" rx="38" ry="32" fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#0d4f49" stroke-width="3"/>
  <ellipse cx="120" cy="174" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#f3d9b0"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="128" cy="108" r="46" fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#0d4f49" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- ear -->
  <path d="M108 70 L100 44 L124 64 Z" fill="#127a70" stroke="#0d4f49" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M109 64 L105 52 L117 62 Z" fill="#f3a9a0"/>

  <!-- goggles strap -->
  <path d="M86 96 Q128 80 172 92" fill="none" stroke="#ff8a1f" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- face / muzzle -->
  <path d="M120 112 Q150 96 176 116 Q178 140 150 146 Q124 146 120 112 Z" fill="#f3d9b0"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="140" cy="104" rx="10" ry="14" fill="#fff" stroke="#0d4f49" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="160" cy="104" rx="9" ry="13" fill="#fff" stroke="#0d4f49" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="144" cy="106" r="5" fill="#6a2fb0"/>
  <circle cx="163" cy="106" r="4.5" fill="#6a2fb0"/>
  <circle cx="145" cy="104" r="1.6" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="164" cy="104" r="1.4" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- nose & smile -->
  <ellipse cx="178" cy="120" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#1b1b1b"/>
  <path d="M148 132 Q160 140 170 130" fill="none" stroke="#0d4f49" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- arm -->
  <path d="M132 162 Q156 150 168 160" fill="none" stroke="#f3d9b0" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="172" cy="160" r="9" fill="#ffd23f" stroke="#a87900" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <path d="M100 196 L94 214" stroke="#127a70" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M126 196 L140 210" stroke="#127a70" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- boots -->
  <path d="M78 214 Q94 204 110 216 Q104 226 80 224 Z" fill="#ff8a1f" stroke="#8a3d00" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <path d="M132 210 Q150 200 166 212 Q160 222 136 220 Z" fill="#ff8a1f" stroke="#8a3d00" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <rect x="80" y="219" width="28" height="4" rx="2" fill="#fff"/>
  <rect x="134" y="215" width="28" height="4" rx="2" fill="#fff"/>
</svg>
```
